hero.title: From idea to implementation, we start here the step
hero.description: Share details of your project, and our CodeTech team will review your needs and contact you to determine the most suitable technical solutions.

project.title: Start a new project
project.description: If you want to build a system, website, or app — or improve work processes — tell us what you need so we can define the right starting point together.

products.title: Product inquiry
products.description: Learn about CodeTech products, discuss fit for your team and business, and explore customization and operation options based on the product.

channels.title: Need to reach the CodeTech team right away?
channels.description: Contact us and we will reply as soon as possible

steps.label: Steps
steps.title: What happens after submitting the request?

01.title: Request received
01.description: We receive your details and needs so we can start the follow-up.

02.title: Needs review
02.description: We review the information and identify what is needed to understand the scope of work.

03.title: Contacting you
03.description: We reach out through the right channel to arrange a discussion of your needs.

04.title: Project discussion
04.description: We discuss goals, users, priorities, integrations, and the expected timeline.

05.title: Sending the right offer
05.description: We present an offer covering solution scope, deliverables, cost, timeline, and assumptions.

form.title: Contact form
